content: drive.file scope is NON-sensitive (per-file access to files the app created/opened) and avoids the heavy verification path. Broad 'drive' scope is RESTRICTED, requiring annual CASA Tier 2 security assessment (2-6 months, costs 0 self-serve up to thousands via third-party assessor) plus reverification every 12 months. Unverified apps are hard-capped at 100 users and show a scary unverified-app warning screen. Decision: design the whole DB to live in app-created files so drive.file suffices and verification/CASA is avoided.
